macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS - protein +9.6% and calories -2.6% are inside tolerance, so portions stand; the beef line is weight-anchored by the source (14 oz stated), not each-assumed, so the florentine failure mode does not apply. The one visible divergence is CARBS: ours 17.2 vs their 9, and it is fully explained by the onion line - their calculator booked '1 yellow onion' at a ~120 g default while the author's own parenthetical says just under 1 lb; we booked the author's pound (see the onion note). Direction is safe: carbs stay well under the 35 g gate either way, and honoring the author's weight is the honest reading of the recipe as cooked.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 521 cal in [400, 650] PASS; carbs 17.2 g <= 35 PASS. No optional lines.
